name: Golemagg the Incinerator
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/molten-core/golemagg.md, corrected by docs/research/molten-core/VERIFICATION.md. Era 40-man: 826,088 HP, 2 Core Ragers (80,925 HP each, unkillable while he lives). Two phases: 100-10% (300 s, condensed from a 5-8 minute fight) and the final 10% (16 s) with Earthquake: compressed, since 82,000 HP at realistic raid DPS is more like 25-35 s, but the player tank model has no healer to save them from Earthquake, and four or five Earthquakes are enough to rehearse walking out. Magma Splash: DBC 13879 procs 25% on his melee target (open question: the tank only, vs guides saying melee DPS stack it too); 93-107 + 50 Fire every 3 s, -250 armor per stack, 30 s. A stacking non-dispellable debuff on the tank about every 8 s (four swings): `maxStacks` 5, 17 a second per stack, `damageTakenMult` 1.04 per stack standing in for the armor loss (a placeholder: no source gives his swing against the armor curve). The real swap at 5-6 stacks is driven by a `targetSwitch` every 40 s: as the tank you Taunt him at the swap, with a press cue, standing in for the actual stack check; stacks do not fall off a swapped tank because the engine has one tank at a time. Pyroblast: a `projectile` at a random target every 7 s (cmangos), 2300 total: 1388-1612 (1500, DBC) + 200 per 3 s for 12 s lumped into the hit (the engine has no projectile DoT). DBC vs wiki (1009 + 84/3 s) vs Ten Ton Hammer (2000 + 200/3 s) are an open question; DBC used. `playerChance` 0.2 (fair odds are 1/40). Earthquake: `aoe` radius 18 from his edge, 1500 (1388-1612), every 3 s from 10% (cmangos), scored with `playerMetric`, with a brief `stun` of 1 s (DBC mechanic Stunned; the length is a placeholder). The phase 2 melee spot sits outside 18 yd, so the ideal marker walks melee out; the tank stays in by design. Enrage at 10% (Ten Ton Hammer "faster attacks"; cmangos has spell 19953 disabled as unconfirmed) is not modelled. Golemagg stands still (`stationary`): real raids tank him where he stands. Core Ragers: an `adds` wave of 2 beside the tank spot 10 s in; the off-tank role holds them (`holdsBoss: false`, a ghost tank has Golemagg) at the back of the cavern, 30+ yd from him; they are not killable and live the whole fight ("die when he dies" per wiki, cmangos and comments; the Wowhead guide text says kill them after, an open question). Golemagg's Trust (+500 damage, +50% speed within 30 yd), Mangle, Refuse Death and Attract Rager are not modelled; adds have no abilities. Boss melee 320 per 2 s is a placeholder scaled to the 10,000 HP tank so a tank arrives at the final 10% near full; Earthquake is the spike that matters there. Engine gaps: no armor, no add abilities or leash, the swap is a scripted beat rather than a real stack count. The healer has no dispels here, only the tank and Pyroblast targets, which matches the real fight.

labels.text: Core Ragers: back of the cavern, 30+ yd from him

meleeOutSpot.label: Melee at 10%: past 18 yd from him

ragerHoldSpot.label: Core Ragers: back of the cavern, 30+ yd from him

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: Tank him where he stands on the north side, so he faces away from the raid. Taunt him off the other Golemagg tank at every swap, and hold him through Earthquake at 10% when everyone else has walked out.

offtank.label: Core Rager off-tank
offtank.description: Your job is the Core Ragers, not Golemagg. Pick them up as they come in and take them to your spot at the back of the cavern, 30+ yd from him: inside 30 yd they gain +500 damage and +50% attack speed. Do not let anyone kill them: they heal to full at 50% and die when he dies.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Behind him, step out when your own Magma Splash stacks get high (the raid calls it), and leave completely at 10%: Earthquake reaches 18 yd every 3 s.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Max range and spread. Pyroblast is random, so spacing does not help, but stay outside 18 yd of him at 10%. Never put damage on the Core Ragers: they heal to full at 50%.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Spike-heal the Pyroblast targets, keep the tank topped through stacking Magma Splash, and at 10% heal the tank through Earthquake every 3 s.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Taunt forces the boss onto you for a few seconds and puts you on top of the threat table. Press it the moment he turns on the raid, never while he is already on you.

attack.label: Attack
attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.

heal.label: Heal the tank
heal.tip: A large heal for the tank. Time it to land with the incoming damage.

magmaSplash.label: Magma Splash
magmaSplash.tip: A melee proc on his target: 93-107 Fire, then 50 per 3 s and -250 armor per stack, 30 s. The tanks swap at 5-6 stacks. Melee also report stacks and step out when theirs get high.

magmaSwap.label: Tank swap
magmaSwap.toast: Five stacks on the other tank. Taunt him now!
magmaSwap.tip: The other Golemagg tank is at 5-6 Magma Splash stacks. Taunt him off them straight away and take the next stint.

pyroblast.label: Pyroblast
pyroblast.tip: 1388-1612 Fire and 800 more over 12 s on a random raid member every 7 s. Healers top up the target at once: it can kill a clothie.

earthquake.label: Earthquake
earthquake.tip: From 10%: 1388-1612 to everyone within 18 yd every 3 s. Only the tank stays. Everyone else walks out at 10% and finishes him from range.

ragers.label: Core Ragers
ragers.tip: Two Core Ragers come with him. Off-tanks drag them to the back and keep them 30+ yd from Golemagg. Do not DPS them: they heal to full at 50% and die when he dies.

aggroPull.label: Aggro pull
aggroPull.tip: Threat is split between two tanks swapping on him. Someone overtakes them.

expectations.label: Pick him up where he stands
expectations.tip: Taunt him and step to the north side so he faces away from the raid. He does not need moving.

expectations.label: Taunt on the swap
expectations.tip: When the other tank hits 5-6 Magma Splash stacks, Taunt him off them straight away. They wait 30 s for the stacks to fall off, then it is their turn again.

expectations.label: Take him back when a DPS pulls aggro
expectations.tip: Threat is split across two tanks, so it is thin. The moment he turns, Taunt.

expectations.label: Pick up the Core Ragers
expectations.tip: Run into them or Taunt one the moment they arrive, then take them to the back of the cavern, 30+ yd from Golemagg.

expectations.label: Keep the Core Ragers off the raid
expectations.tip: A Rager in the raid is a tank-killer on a healer. Hold them at the back, 30+ yd from Golemagg.

expectations.label: Never pull aggro off the tank
expectations.tip: Stop attacking while the threat bar is red. Resume when it leaves the red band.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Magma Splash ticks and armor loss stack on the tank. Keep them topped between swaps.

expectations.label: Be 18 yd out when the Earthquakes start
expectations.tip: At 10% melee stop hitting and walk straight out. Ranged finish him; every Earthquake that catches you is 1500.

expectations.label: Keep the tank alive
expectations.tip: Earthquake is 1500 on the tank every 3 s on top of his hits. Do nothing but heal them.

threatLostCount.label: Times he turned on the raid

aggroPulls.label: Times you pulled aggro
aggroPulls.tip: Stop attacking when the threat bar turns red.

attacksInRed.label: Attacks in the red band
attacksInRed.tip: Stop attacking in the red band so the tank can regain a threat lead.

earlyAttacks.label: Attacks before the tank had him
earlyAttacks.tip: Give the tank a few seconds after the pull.

earlyPulls.label: You pulled him before the tank

dpsIdle.label: Seconds not attacking when you could
dpsIdle.tip: Keep attacking when it's safe. Stop if the threat bar turns red or the boss leaves the tank.

outOfRange.label: Seconds out of range
outOfRange.tip: In phase one you should be attacking. At 10% melee are out of range on purpose.

playerInHazard.label: Seconds standing in fire
playerInHazard.tip: Move out of the fire before attacking again.

tankLowSeconds.label: Seconds with the tank under half
tankLowSeconds.tip: Top the tank up before the spike lands, not after.

overheals.label: Wasted heals
overheals.tip: Avoid healing the tank at full health. Save the heal for incoming damage.

whelpsOnRaid.label: Adds on the raid
whelpsOnRaid.tip: Grab the adds before they reach a raid member and keep them on you.

earthquakesTaken.label: Earthquakes you stood in
earthquakesTaken.tip: Walk out at 10%. 18 yd from his edge.

cues.notes: Press notes: Taunt on the swap (he comes off the other tank) and when he turns on the raid; Heal when the tank is low.

list.label: Taunt when Golemagg turns on the raid
list.tip: The moment he turns, Taunt. Every second he is on the raid someone is dying.

list.label: Heal the tank when they drop low
list.tip: The tank is below half health and a big hit is coming. Heal now.

list.label: Pick up the Core Ragers
list.tip: Taunt one or run into them as they arrive.

drills.name: Core Rager pickup
drills.description: Pick up the Core Ragers and take them to the back of the cavern, 30+ yd from him.

drills.name: Tank swap
drills.description: Already on him. The swap comes every 15 s; Taunt him the moment it does, and catch him again if a DPS pulls.

drills.name: Earthquake walk-out
drills.description: Final 10%: Earthquake every 3 s. Stay outside 18 yd of him.

drills.name: Healing through Earthquake
drills.description: Earthquake every 3 s on the tank. Heal only the tank, watch for the Pyroblast, and do not waste a heal on someone at full.
